g.text: FIX4.0 — one continuous closed border per box
Same coordinates as the outermost floating-roof roads. No circles or narrow inlet passages in these border loops.
Each loop closes at its starting point, then retracts and lifts.2 mm/s • width0.30 • flow1.4 • K0.05 • fan100% • acceleration2500.
